description: One generic SDK package (ports + adapters, npm, TypeScript strict, tsup ESM+CJS, jest coverage gate, loop test, package smoke, `npm run verify`) = `common/` skeleton + one `kinds/<kind>/` overlay. The overlay is copied over the skeleton (overlay wins); every token below is substituted in file contents and in paths; `skip` globs are never copied; `post_generate` runs inside the generated package. Output directory: `__SYSTEM_SLUG__-<kind>` (= `__SDK_DIR_<kind>__`).

placeholder_docs.__SYSTEM_NAME__: Human name of the system (e.g. `Acme Shop`); used in prose only.
placeholder_docs.__SYSTEM_PREFIX__: Upper-case system prefix (e.g. `ACM`); reserved for cross-package codes, not used by the SDK files themselves.
placeholder_docs.__NPM_SCOPE__: npm scope with the `@` (e.g. `@acme`); the package is `__NPM_SCOPE__/<kind>`.
placeholder_docs.__SDK_DIR_<kind>__: Directory of that kind's package = `__SYSTEM_SLUG__-<kind>`; one token per kind so a package can name itself or a sibling.
placeholder_docs.__SERVER_DIR__: Directory of the backend that consumes the SDKs (e.g. `acme-server`).
placeholder_docs.__OWNER_GITHUB__: GitHub owner of the repository (`repository.url` in package.json).
placeholder_docs.__SDK_KIND__: Per kind, filled by the engine from `kinds.<kind>` (the key): `storage` | `otp` | `notifications` | `payments` | `analytics`. Package name suffix and `provider` namespace.
placeholder_docs.__SDK_PREFIX__: Per kind, from `kinds.<kind>.prefix`: error-code and task-ID prefix (`STO_CONFIG_INVALID`, `STO-001`); env keys in `.env.example`.
placeholder_docs.__SDK_TITLE__: Per kind, from `kinds.<kind>.title`: one PascalCase word used in identifiers (`createStorage`) and doc file names (`docs/Storage_BRD.md`).

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Object storage: presigned uploads + confirmation, CDN URLs, signed private URLs; S3-compatible (SigV4, no vendor SDK), memory and fake adapters.

otp.title: Otp
otp.description: One-time codes: code store + delivery channel ports, request/verify/consume with limits and single-use tokens; memory store, fake channel.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Push + email ports behind one notifier with idempotency; fake adapters for both.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Checkout session / verify / refund / webhook ports, no vendor: fake gateway + localhost mock gateway (HTTP) with its generic adapter.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: track / linkIdentity / flush ports with batching; fake, memory and generic HTTP collector adapters.
